spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)                                                        AS "Games",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won)                                     AS "Wins",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT won)                                 AS "Losses",
       COUNT(DISTINCT series_id)                                       AS "Series",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE $__timeFilter(played_on)

spec.description: Every game logged in the selected time range.
spec.title: Overall record

spec.rawSql:
SELECT my_leader || '  (' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS "Legend",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY my_leader
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Legends with at least 5 games. Sample size in brackets.
spec.title: Win rate by legend

spec.rawSql:
SELECT my_leader                                               AS "Leader",
       opp_domain                                              AS "vs Domain",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Games",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM (
       SELECT my_leader, opp_domain_1 AS opp_domain, won, played_on FROM games
       UNION ALL
       SELECT my_leader, opp_domain_2 AS opp_domain, won, played_on FROM games
     ) x
WHERE opp_domain IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC

spec.description: How each of your leaders performs against each opposing domain. Both of the opponent's domains count, so a game lands in two rows. Cells with at least 3 games.
spec.title: Leader vs opposing domain

spec.rawSql:
SELECT my_leader                                               AS "Me",
       opp_leader                                              AS "Them",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Games",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won)                             AS "W",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT won)                         AS "L",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

spec.description: Matchups you've played at least twice.
spec.title: Matchup matrix

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN went_first THEN 'Went first' ELSE 'Went second' END AS "Start",
       COUNT(*)                                                      AS "Games",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1)      AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE went_first IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Only games where you recorded it.
spec.title: On the play

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 'Game ' || game_in_series                               AS "Game",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Games",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE game_in_series IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Do you close out game 3s?
spec.title: By game in series

spec.rawSql:
SELECT event_type                                              AS "Event",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Games",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT played_on AS time,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won)) OVER (ORDER BY played_on)
                   / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY played_on), 1) AS "Cumulative win %"
FROM games
WHERE $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY played_on
ORDER BY played_on

spec.description: Running win rate across every game to date. Smooths out single bad nights.
spec.title: Cumulative win rate over time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT location                                              AS "Location",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Games",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Win %"
FROM games
WHERE location IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(played_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Where you played. Ordered by games logged.
spec.title: Win rate by location

spec.rawSql: SELECT SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS "Total packs" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)

spec.description: Every pack / sleeve / vault logged in range. This is the denominator for every rate below.
spec.title: Total packs opened

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(hit_epic + hit_fa_rune + hit_sig_spell + hit_alt_art + hit_sp_rare + hit_overnumber + hit_signature + hit_ultimate + hit_nn_chase)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END),0), 2) AS "Hits per pack" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)

spec.description: Tier 3+ pulls per pack opened. A 'hit' = Epic and above.
spec.title: Hits per pack

spec.rawSql: SELECT SUM(hit_signature + hit_ultimate + hit_nn_chase) AS "Chase pulls" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)

spec.description: Total T6 pulls: Signature + Ultimate + Nexus Night Chase.
spec.title: Chase pulls

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hit_dbl_leader),0) AS "Double Leader packs" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)

spec.description: Total Double Leader pulls logged. The bad-beat tier — below the normal floor.
spec.title: Double Leader packs

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(v.tier * v.cnt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(v.cnt),0), 2) AS "Avg pull tier" FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1, po.hit_dbl_leader),(2, po.hit_leader),(2, po.hit_rare),(3, po.hit_epic),(3, po.hit_fa_rune),(3, po.hit_sig_spell),(4, po.hit_alt_art),(4, po.hit_sp_rare),(5, po.hit_overnumber),(6, po.hit_signature),(6, po.hit_ultimate),(6, po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(tier, cnt) WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on)

spec.description: Weighted mean tier across all pulls (T1 worst -> T6 chase). Higher = luckier mix.
spec.title: Avg pull tier

spec.rawSql: WITH tiers(tier, p, points) AS (VALUES (3, 0.25, 4),(4, 0.083, 12),(5, 0.014, 72),(6, 0.0014, 720)) SELECT ROUND(SUM(v.cnt * COALESCE(t.points,0))::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)),0), 2) AS "Pack Luck Score" FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1, po.hit_dbl_leader),(2, po.hit_leader),(2, po.hit_rare),(3, po.hit_epic),(3, po.hit_fa_rune),(3, po.hit_sig_spell),(4, po.hit_alt_art),(4, po.hit_sp_rare),(5, po.hit_overnumber),(6, po.hit_signature),(6, po.hit_ultimate),(6, po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(tier, cnt) LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.tier = v.tier WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on)

spec.description: Avg points per pack. Point weight = 1/p per hit (T3=4, T4=12, T5=72, T6=720). 4 = baseline expected: green above, red below.
spec.title: Pack Luck Score

spec.rawSql: SELECT v.rarity AS "Rarity", SUM(v.cnt) AS "Pulls" FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Double Leader',1,po.hit_dbl_leader),('Leader',2,po.hit_leader),('Rare',2,po.hit_rare),('Epic',3,po.hit_epic),('Full Art Rune',3,po.hit_fa_rune),('Signature Spell',3,po.hit_sig_spell),('Alt Art',4,po.hit_alt_art),('SP Rare',4,po.hit_sp_rare),('Overnumber',5,po.hit_overnumber),('Signature',6,po.hit_signature),('Ultimate',6,po.hit_ultimate),('Nexus Night Chase',6,po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(rarity, tier, cnt) WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) GROUP BY v.rarity, v.tier ORDER BY v.tier, v.rarity

spec.description: Total pulls of each hit type, ordered by tier from worst (Double Leader) to best (chase).
spec.title: Pulls by rarity

spec.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS packs FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)) SELECT v.rarity AS "Rarity", 'T' || v.tier AS "Tier", SUM(v.cnt) AS "Pulled", CASE WHEN SUM(v.cnt) = 0 THEN '—' WHEN SUM(v.cnt) >= (SELECT packs FROM totals) THEN ROUND(SUM(v.cnt)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT packs FROM totals),0), 2)::text || ' per pack' ELSE '1 in ' || ROUND((SELECT packs FROM totals)::numeric / SUM(v.cnt))::text || ' packs' END AS "Rate" FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Double Leader',1,po.hit_dbl_leader),('Leader',2,po.hit_leader),('Rare',2,po.hit_rare),('Epic',3,po.hit_epic),('Full Art Rune',3,po.hit_fa_rune),('Signature Spell',3,po.hit_sig_spell),('Alt Art',4,po.hit_alt_art),('SP Rare',4,po.hit_sp_rare),('Overnumber',5,po.hit_overnumber),('Signature',6,po.hit_signature),('Ultimate',6,po.hit_ultimate),('Nexus Night Chase',6,po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(rarity, tier, cnt) WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) GROUP BY v.rarity, v.tier ORDER BY v.tier, v.rarity

spec.description: Per-rarity totals and pull rate. Adaptive: >= once per pack shows 'X per pack', otherwise '1 in X packs'. Sorted by tier then rarity.
spec.title: Per-rarity rate

spec.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', acquired_on) AS "time", ROUND(SUM(hit_epic + hit_fa_rune + hit_sig_spell + hit_alt_art + hit_sp_rare + hit_overnumber + hit_signature + hit_ultimate + hit_nn_chase)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END),0), 2) AS "Hits per pack" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: T3+ hits per pack, grouped by week.
spec.title: Hits per pack over time (weekly)

spec.rawSql: WITH tiers(tier, p, points) AS (VALUES (3, 0.25, 4),(4, 0.083, 12),(5, 0.014, 72),(6, 0.0014, 720)), pts AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', po.acquired_on) AS wk, SUM(v.cnt * COALESCE(t.points,0)) AS points FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1, po.hit_dbl_leader),(2, po.hit_leader),(2, po.hit_rare),(3, po.hit_epic),(3, po.hit_fa_rune),(3, po.hit_sig_spell),(4, po.hit_alt_art),(4, po.hit_sp_rare),(5, po.hit_overnumber),(6, po.hit_signature),(6, po.hit_ultimate),(6, po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(tier, cnt) LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.tier = v.tier WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) GROUP BY 1), q AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', acquired_on) AS wk, SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS packs FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on) GROUP BY 1) SELECT q.wk AS "time", ROUND(pts.points::numeric / NULLIF(q.packs,0), 2) AS "Luck score" FROM q JOIN pts ON pts.wk = q.wk ORDER BY q.wk

spec.description: Weekly Pack Luck Score (points per pack). Amber line marks the baseline of 4.
spec.title: Luck score over time (weekly)

spec.rawSql: SELECT s.set_name AS "Set", ROUND((SUM(s.hits) FILTER (WHERE s.product <> 'Prize Nexus Night Pack'))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.packs) FILTER (WHERE s.product <> 'Prize Nexus Night Pack'),0), 2) AS "Booster", ROUND((SUM(s.hits) FILTER (WHERE s.product = 'Prize Nexus Night Pack'))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.packs) FILTER (WHERE s.product = 'Prize Nexus Night Pack'),0), 2) AS "Nexus Night" FROM (SELECT set_name, product, acquired_on, (hit_epic + hit_fa_rune + hit_sig_spell + hit_alt_art + hit_sp_rare + hit_overnumber + hit_signature + hit_ultimate + hit_nn_chase) AS hits, quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END AS packs FROM openings) s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_on) GROUP BY s.set_name ORDER BY s.set_name

spec.description: T3+ hits per pack by set, split by pack type. Prize Nexus Night Packs are 3-card packs with different odds, so their rate is kept separate from boosters (which include Vault packs at 6x).
spec.title: Hits per pack by set

spec.rawSql: SELECT product AS "Product", ROUND(SUM(hit_epic + hit_fa_rune + hit_sig_spell + hit_alt_art + hit_sp_rare + hit_overnumber + hit_signature + hit_ultimate + hit_nn_chase)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END),0), 2) AS "Hits per pack" FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on) GROUP BY product ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: T3+ hits per pack, by product type.
spec.title: Hits per pack by product

spec.rawSql: WITH tiers(tier, p, points) AS (VALUES (3, 0.25, 4),(4, 0.083, 12),(5, 0.014, 72),(6, 0.0014, 720)), totals AS (SELECT SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS packs FROM openings WHERE $__timeFilter(acquired_on)), actual AS (SELECT v.tier, SUM(v.cnt) AS pulls FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (3,po.hit_epic),(3,po.hit_fa_rune),(3,po.hit_sig_spell),(4,po.hit_alt_art),(4,po.hit_sp_rare),(5,po.hit_overnumber),(6,po.hit_signature),(6,po.hit_ultimate),(6,po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(tier, cnt) WHERE $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) GROUP BY v.tier) SELECT 'T' || t.tier AS "Tier", (SELECT packs FROM totals) AS "Packs", COALESCE(a.pulls, 0) AS "Actual", ROUND((SELECT packs FROM totals) * t.p, 1) AS "Expected", ROUND(COALESCE(a.pulls,0) - (SELECT packs FROM totals) * t.p, 1) AS "Delta" FROM tiers t LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.tier = t.tier ORDER BY t.tier

spec.description: Expected = total packs * baseline p. Delta = actual - expected (green = luckier than baseline, red = unluckier). 'Packs' column shows sample size so small-n noise is obvious.
spec.title: Expected vs actual by tier

spec.rawSql: SELECT po.acquired_on AS "Date", po.set_name AS "Set", po.product AS "Product", v.rarity AS "Chase", v.cnt AS "Count" FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Signature', po.hit_signature),('Ultimate', po.hit_ultimate),('Nexus Night Chase', po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(rarity, cnt) WHERE v.cnt > 0 AND $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) ORDER BY po.acquired_on DESC

spec.description: Every T6 chase pull: Signature, Ultimate, Nexus Night Chase. Count > 1 means multiple from one opening.
spec.title: Chase log

spec.rawSql: WITH tiers(tier, p, points) AS (VALUES (3, 0.25, 4),(4, 0.083, 12),(5, 0.014, 72),(6, 0.0014, 720)), pts AS (SELECT po.location AS loc, SUM(v.cnt * COALESCE(t.points,0)) AS points FROM openings po CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1, po.hit_dbl_leader),(2, po.hit_leader),(2, po.hit_rare),(3, po.hit_epic),(3, po.hit_fa_rune),(3, po.hit_sig_spell),(4, po.hit_alt_art),(4, po.hit_sp_rare),(5, po.hit_overnumber),(6, po.hit_signature),(6, po.hit_ultimate),(6, po.hit_nn_chase)) AS v(tier, cnt) LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.tier = v.tier WHERE po.location IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(po.acquired_on) GROUP BY po.location), q AS (SELECT location AS loc, SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN product = 'Vault' THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS packs FROM openings WHERE location IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(acquired_on) GROUP BY location) SELECT q.loc || '  (' || q.packs || ')' AS "Store", ROUND(pts.points::numeric / NULLIF(q.packs,0), 2) AS "Luck score" FROM q JOIN pts ON pts.loc = q.loc ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Pack Luck Score (avg points per pack) per store, pack count in brackets. Same point weights as the headline. Green = at/above baseline 4, red = below.
spec.title: Luck score by store
